scope: Cloud appearance/cost iteration in the existing real-time RR renderer. Does not complete the broader cinematic renderer goal.

measurement.timestamps: Vulkan GPU timestamps, screenshots after timed interval
measurement.gpuScope: world.total includes the world render and final presentation, excludes subsequent GUI
measurement.cloudScope: Sum of cloud.* passes excluding diagnostic passes; final display adds about 0.035 ms over stage 0
measurement.baseline: Stage 0 of the current realtime/RR graph, not the old user-installed SR pack. Shared new bindings/clear-base/noise resources exist in all stages.
measurement.cpuCaveat: Windows active-thread clock is coarse (15.625 ms quanta). Mean retained as evidence, unsuitable for sub-ms CPU attribution.
measurement.vramCaveat: Device-wide nvidia-smi WDDM samples retained with each run; not process residency or per-stage VRAM attribution.

steps.change: Conservative weather-cell empty skipping, adaptive distance steps, remove nested column density substeps
steps.decision: Keep: dominant measured saving, similar image before detail work

steps.change: Hardware trilinear coarse shape and boundary erosion; varied base/top; three local sun probes plus cached lighting and silver rim; opacity contrast
steps.decision: Keep: sharper cloud edges and billow contrast visible, incremental whole-frame price below 1 ms

steps.change: Depth-compatible clamped cubic upsample; variance-clipped motion-responsive history with valid alpha clip interval; horizon fade; compose after RR before display mapping
steps.decision: Keep: preserves fine silhouette that RR blurred. No higher cloud dimensions.

day.scope: Adjacent prescribed camera frames, frozen weather/time. Readbacks are untimed and GIF is slowed to 100 ms/frame, not runtime FPS. Does not prove all camera speeds or cloud animation are artifact-free.

reports.uniformComparisonScope: All actual uniform bytes except graph-local AS generation/pending words and (foliage mode only) emitter buffer device address. Pending must be zero and exact source geometry matches independently. Emitter count and every physical camera/environment value must match. Raw uniform bytes retained without modification.

stability.reloadAndResize: Passed in guard-day-1; actual RR recreation and GPU resource retirement logged
stability.limits: Not a 32-chunk, long-session, storm, fast-flight or inside-cloud stress result. Eight matched adjacent frames cover the prescribed short turn/walk only.

visualAssessment.day: Visible smaller edge breakup and sharper silhouettes; less diffuse woolly blending.
visualAssessment.sunset: Warm gold/orange retained; reduced grey low-horizon film. Flat bases still occur and art direction remains subjective.
visualAssessment.motion: No obvious dragged cloud silhouette in the inspected eight-frame pairs. This is a visual observation, not proof of zero temporal artifact at all speeds.
visualAssessment.notClaimed: No physical accuracy, universal 60 FPS, universal artifact-free sky or user acceptance claim.

failedAndSuperseded.qa-cloud-art-resolve-day-1: Invalid cloud.transport display binding; startup rejected. Corrected to cloud.compose.coefficients.
failedAndSuperseded.preRRSharpen: Cubic filtering before RR alone had little visible value; superseded by post-RR cloud composition.
failedAndSuperseded.alphaGuard: Final guard runs include the correction that prevents an empty variance/alpha history clip interval.
